hook: Every hyperbolic knot has a braid diagram where each crossing is faithfully tracked, settling a conjecture
summary: The paper proves that any hyperbolic knot has a closed braid diagram with distinct parabolic fixed points at every crossing, answering a conjecture of McPhail-Snyder. The proof rewrites a troublesome crossing as five ordinary ones, using at most 2n-1 letters per replaced crossing on n strands. It is a pure existence result and does not address how to find the shortest such diagram.
title: Every hyperbolic knot has an arc-faithful closed braid diagram
